terms.meaning: a shared place in the app that holds data such as the logged-in user and the profiles
a small menu that opens when a button is clicked

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and setup for profile menu
sections.what: Brings in the menu parts, buttons, the link component and the shared sign-in store. It sets this file as a browser-only component so it can use clicks and state.
sections.why: The file needs menu pieces from the design library, the stored list of profiles, and a link to the family page. Reason for the browser-only marker is partly visible: the component uses clicks and local state.
sections.watch_out: The store path and the family page route must stay correct, because a wrong path stops the whole menu from building.

sections.name: ProfileSwitcher (part 1)
sections.title: Dropdown that switches the active profile
sections.what: Shows the currently selected family member's initial, name and relationship in a button. Opening it lists every profile with its own initial. Choosing one changes the active profile for the whole app. If nothing is selected, it shows the first profile, or a placeholder called Select Profile.
sections.why: Lets one account switch between patients or family members without logging in again. The fallback placeholder keeps the button from being empty before profiles load.
sections.watch_out: The profile list is loaded once when the component first appears. Profiles added elsewhere will not show here until the page reloads.

sections.name: ProfileSwitcher (part 2)
sections.title: Link to manage family members
sections.what: At the bottom of the menu, a link named Manage Family Members that opens the family page.
sections.why: Gives a shortcut from the switcher to where profiles are added or edited.

summary: A dropdown in the dashboard that shows the currently selected family member and lets the user switch between profiles or open the family management page.
purpose: Lets someone managing several patient profiles see who is active and change the active profile in one click.
why: Header says seamless patient context switching. Reason for placing it here is not stated in the code.
how: On load it asks the auth store to fetch profiles. It shows the selected profile's initial and name, or a placeholder if none is found. Opening the menu lists every profile, and clicking one stores it as the selected profile. A link at the bottom goes to the family page.
inputs: The profile list, selected profile id, and the fetch and select actions, all from the auth store. User clicks on the menu.
outputs: A button showing the active profile, and a menu. Choosing a profile updates the selected profile id in the store.
risks: If no profiles load, the placeholder named Select Profile shows and the menu is empty. If fetching fails, nothing tells the user why.
debug: If the wrong person's data appears, check the selected profile id in the auth store and what setSelectedProfileId receives. If the list is empty, check fetchProfiles in the auth store and its network call. Confirm the /family route exists.
